name: Inner Mongolia ERDOS Resources Co.,Ltd.
summary: Inner Mongolia ERDOS Resources Co.,Ltd. engages in clothing, power metallurgy, and chemical businesses in China. It offers knitted garments, including coarse/fine spun fabrics, scarves and shawls, cashmere blankets, cashmere coats. The company is also involved in the processing and sale of electricity, silicon-based ferroalloys, chlor-alkali chemicals, synthetic ammonia, urea, and other products; mining and beneficiation of coal and other mineral resources; water diversion, water supply, and sewage treatment; and sale of mining equipment.
